name: Hentzau Initials
notes: Huge flourished blackletter cadels with hairline scrollwork spilling far past the em box (wider than the cell); uppercase only

name: Victorian Initials One
notes: Engraved script capitals wreathed in small flowers, berries and vines, with a flourish; light and airy; uppercase only

name: Elzevier Caps
designer: Dieter Steffmann (Typographer Mediengestaltung), from David Rakowski's EPS art
notes: Roman caps wrapped in whiplash stems, tulips and wheat ears, no ground; a-z is the same set

name: Starburst
designer: David Rakowski; German characters added by Dieter Steffmann
notes: Heavy geometric sans caps sliced by white sunburst rays radiating from a point inside each letter; a-z almost identical
